prerequisite: The drawing already has profile views and the target band styles exist under BandStyles
assertions: data.views_scanned == total number of profile views in the drawing
data.views_mismatched is empty (band count matches the length of the given array)
data.bands_changed == views_changed * number of non-empty positions in the array
dry_run per_view[].fingerprint is position-wise identical across views (generated from the same band set, so the position order is trustworthy)
after saving, open Profile View Properties -> Bands in CAD and check the style names visually -- BandStyleId is write-only, so the program cannot read it back to prove itself
note: Field record (2026-08-27, a main-channel calculation drawing): 21 views x 4 bottom bands swapped in one pass to C3DF-GroundElevation/C3DF-DesignElevation/C3DF-CutFillDepth/C3DF-Station, bands_changed=84, mismatched=0; fingerprints identical across all 21 views (ProfileData, gap=0, major=50, minor=10, label_end=true, weeding=100). Two traps: (1) BandStyleId is write-only in the Civil 2025 managed API (proven by a reflection probe), so bands can only be swapped by position, never mapped by old name or read back for verification; (2) save_dwg (managed db.SaveAs) threw eFilerError on this drawing; the native SAVEAS command saved fine -- non-ASCII paths in a scr file get mangled to ? by ASCII encoding, so write to an ASCII path first and move the file back.
